response.sql: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM regional) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amount) AS mean_of_avg_amount, AVG(r.txn_count) AS mean_txn_count, AVG(r.avg_amount - o.mean_avg) AS mean_excess FROM regional r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.avg_amount > o.mean_avg
